title: LTAP/OD — unprotected left across opposing through traffic
originalIntent: The ego turns left across the path of an opposing through vehicle at an intersection. The opposing vehicle must actually reach the shared conflict point inside a critical gap, the ego must genuinely be threatened, and the episode must be collision-free and physically avoidable. This is NHTSA pre-crash typology LTAP/OD, the highest-value urban intersection archetype.
